_about: Editable copy for plan_interiors.js (INT3, 30 Sep 2026): the clubhouse bartender, the restaurant server, the five restaurant venues (name, tagline, chalkboard menu, booth leather, feature wall) and the hangar home room notes. {club} and {venue} are filled in for the building the person stands in. Talk nodes: t = what they say, o = options [label, next node index or null to close]. No prices, no percentages.

bartender.name: Marco
greet: The fire is lit, make yourself at home.

talk.t: Evening, welcome to {club}. The fire is lit and the bar is open. What can I do for you?
Tonight it is a prickly pear spritz, or a mesquite smoked old fashioned if you like a little smoke. There is a desert botanical tonic for anyone skipping the spirits.

The lounge is yours: leather chairs round the fire. The Grill Room runs along the back with the whole course through the glass, the pro shop is across the lobby, and the concierge can book a tee time or a table.
Take the stair by the heritage photographs up to the roof lounge. Glass on four sides, and the best seat on the property at sunset.
Coming right up. Find a seat by the fire and I will bring it over.
Welcome to {venue}. Sit anywhere you like, the booths are the best seats in the house. Can I get you started with something?
Everything on the board over the pass is made here this morning. First time in? Start with the house special and save room for dessert.
The kitchen is open, so you can watch the line work the grill right through the pass. The chefs change the specials with whatever the growers bring in.
The bar takes orders any time: walk up to the counter. The host by the door can find you a table too.

bay.p: Park a light jet or a turboprop a few steps from the living room, behind a glass hangar door that lifts in one piece. Epoxy floor, LED high bays, room for the cart beside the wing.

great.p: The living room looks straight through a full-height glass wall into the hangar bay. The pitched timber ceiling rises to the ridge; the lounge, the dining table and the kitchen share the one room.

kitchen.k: A marble island, walnut and steel
kitchen.p: A waterfall marble island with seating for three, a professional range under a steel hood and full-height walnut pantry and refrigerator columns, all tucked under the mezzanine.

suite.p: The principal bedroom sits on the mezzanine behind a glass balustrade: wake up over the great room with the aircraft beyond the glass.

office.k: A desk with a view of the bay
office.p: A walnut desk faces the balustrade and the hangar bay, with bookcases along the side wall.

entry.p: The front door opens into a gallery along the hangar glass, so the first thing you see is the aircraft. The wine wall is on your right; a few steps lead down into the great room.
